The '''Masla sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered the [[Halm sector/Legends|Halm]], [[Tashtor sector|Tashtor]], [[Narrant sector/Legends|Narrant]], [[Almak sector/Legends|Almak]], [[Elbaran sector/Legends|Elbaran]], [[Iska sector/Legends|Iska]] and [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan sectors]] in the Mid Rim.
